attempts.sql:
WITH FilteredOrders AS (
    SELECT SalesOrderID
    FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader
    WHERE OrderDate >= @start_date
      AND OrderDate < DATEADD(day, 1, @end_date)
)
SELECT 
    pc.Name AS Category,
    SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS Units,
    ROUND(SUM(sod.LineTotal), 2) AS Sales
FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod
JOIN FilteredOrders fo ON sod.SalesOrderID = fo.SalesOrderID
JOIN Production.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = psc.ProductSubcategoryID
JOIN Production.ProductCategory pc ON psc.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
GROUP BY pc.Name
ORDER BY pc.Name;
attempts.explanation: The query first filters SalesOrderHeader to get SalesOrderIDs within the inclusive date range using a CTE. It then joins SalesOrderDetail to these orders, and traverses Product -> ProductSubcategory -> ProductCategory to get the category name. Aggregation sums OrderQty and LineTotal per category, with Sales rounded to 2 decimals. Results are ordered by Category name.
